title: A customer change keeps the line's mark and offers new originals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, line 2 marked No Charge under Comeback.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click "Change Customer" on the customer card.
  3. Pick customer B.
  4. Confirm the change.
  5. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  6. Click "Change category".
  7. Open the "Original work order" select.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The window opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer B is picked.

Step 4:

  • Line 2 still shows "No Charge · Comeback".

Step 5:

  • The menu shows "Change category".

Step 6:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 7:

  • Work order 2, customer B's, is offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E2: “If the customer of the work order changes (S2-R7), no-charge lines keep their mark; the original work order list in Change category now offers the new customer's work orders and the stored original stays until changed.”
